(2) The man stands in a large exhibition hall in front of a giant digital screen displaying a colorful, futuristic interface for the 'Young Designers' Exhibition.' Lush green trees and concrete pillars of a building provide a natural backdrop. (6) A graphic end screen appears, featuring a central rectangular image of the man making a surprised face. The background is white with a paper-texture effect. Various Traditional Chinese text elements, search icons, and a social media call-to-action are neatly arranged around the central photo.
